Question Choices: A bar graph of pages read shows: Monday 6, Tuesday 9, Wednesday 4, Thursday 5, Friday 11. Pages read on Tuesday and Thursday total = ____
Solution: Tuesday has 9 pages and Thursday has 5. Add: 9+5 = 14 pages.

Question Choices: A bar graph of pages read shows: Monday 6, Tuesday 9, Wednesday 4, Thursday 5, Friday 11. How many MORE pages were read on Friday than Wednesday?
Solution: Friday has 11 pages and Wednesday has 4. Subtract: 11-4 = 7 more pages.
